title: On the Restricted Edge-Cuts of Optimal 1-Planar Graphs
summary: The restricted edge-connectivity of a graph is the minimum size of an edge-cut whose removal leaves every component with at least two vertices. In 2024, Zhang et al. showed that the restricted edge-connectivity of any optimal $1$-planar graph belongs to $\{8,10,12\}$. In this paper, we exclude $8$ as a possible value, thereby proving that the restricted edge-connectivity is either $10$ or $12$, and both values are attainable.
